name: Unholy Ice
summary: Shape frozen unholy water into a wall or a volley of javelins.
description: Use the wall or javelin rules of Holy Ice. Replace holy water with unholy water in the material and in all damage and susceptibility rules.
components: M (a flask of unholy water or 5 pounds of powdered silver worth 25 gp)
effect: wall of ice or flying ice javelins (see text)
duration: 1 minute/level, instantaneous, or until expended (see text)
